author: Stocklaw
quote:
What an incredible disappointment. Lucia is a terrible, unlikable person surrounded by equally terrible people who constantly enable and justify her decisions. It’s difficult to care about a story when the characters are this insufferable and the writing expects you to sympathize with them.

Rockstar spent years and an absurd amount of money developing this game, yet somehow managed to lose sight of what made GTA such a beloved franchise in the first place. Impressive graphics and a massive open world mean very little when the characters and story fail to deliver.

I’ve loved this franchise for decades, which makes this even more disappointing. GTA used to have an identity, a certain charm, humor, and attitude that made it special. That seems to be gone now. Rockstar had every opportunity to deliver something extraordinary and instead gave us something that feels completely disconnected from the franchise I grew up loving.

What a waste of potential. Shame on Rockstar. GTA deserved so much better.

author: Stocklaw
quote: This is the most predatory and deceitful game that has ever been released by Sony and may be a lm unfortunate sign of what we can expect as this video games become the playground of addicts and those with low financial intelligence or education. Sony has used the good will of Sony, PlayStation and the Gran Turismo franchise to pull fans and newcomers into an always online, in-game purchase driven disaster of what used to be a respected game series. Sony has shown their hand, and we all must be sure never to pre-order or buy games published by Sony until a month or two have passed. They added even more pressure to utilize their predatory large-transaction credit system to sanely obtain a new car without playing the same race for days. I have deleted the game and have learned my lesson. Be warned: Sony is now turning their largest franchises into glorified mobile cash grabs while charging $70 as an entry fee. Wait for a few months to pass before purchasing Sony games in order to ensure they are not selling you a scam. This game is not worth $70 dollars. It isn’t worth a single dollar. It is a free to play whale-hunting game taking advantage of the name of a once great franchise. PlayStation owners take heed and be skeptical of Sony published games moving forward. Wait until they show you their true intentions. While we love these franchises there is something more valuable - Trust. And Sony should be aware that trust is extremely difficult to earn once it is lost.
